description: Returns latest live weather station observations from Veðurstofa Íslands (api.vedur.is/weather 10-min AWS & SYNOP) and optional short-term XML forecast (xmlweather.vedur.is) for a town or station in Iceland.

include_forecast.description: Include short-term XML forecast entries when available (default true).

place.description: Icelandic town, landmark, or station name (e.g. Reykjavík, Keflavík, Grindavík, Vík, Selfoss, Höfn, Akureyri, Egilsstaðir, Ísafjörður).

name: get_weather
title: Get Weather Observations & Forecast for Iceland
